dep.badGuests: The number of covers must be a whole number between 1 and 100
dep.errSave: Could not update the automatic deposit
dep.intro: For requests from the /prenota form the system generates a {{provider}} payment link automatically and texts it to the customer. The amount and threshold below also apply to phone bookings and to the terms published on /prenota.
dep.perPersonHint: Multiplied by the number of covers. It appears in the messages to the customer and in the "Deposit and cancellations" section of the booking page.
dep.threshold: Ask for a deposit from (number of covers)
dep.thresholdHint: Bookings with at least this many people get the payment link. Below the threshold nothing changes.

exp.badHours: The hours must be a whole number between 1 and 168
exp.errSave: Could not update the link expiry
exp.title: Automatic link expiry
exp.intro: After the threshold the link can no longer be paid and a booking waiting on a deposit is declined. It applies to links from the last 7 days; table bill shares are excluded.
exp.msgDeclined: Booking not confirmed (the same wording as a manual decline)
exp.msgHint: It goes out on the channel set in the source's Reply channels (WhatsApp falling back to SMS, email).

source.MANUALHint: With blocking on, saving is refused to the staff too.
source.GOOGLEHint: With blocking on, the form answers with an invitation to call.
source.VOICEHint: With blocking on, Sofia declines with a polite sentence.
source.WHATSAPPHint: With blocking on, booking proposals are refused.

bl.intro: What happens when a booking comes from a number on the blacklist. The signs in the dining room (banner, badge, address book) stay visible whatever you choose.

chg.badService: The service charge must be a whole number between 0 and 100
chg.intro: They appear as bill lines and get discounted like the others. At zero they do not appear. Open orders adjust at the next entry.
chg.vatHint: The VAT rates for cover and service are set in the VAT mapping, under Tax.
